Sterling & Wilson Data Center Pvt. Ltd. (SWDC) began its journey as part of Sterling & Wilson Pvt. Ltd., drawing from its nearly century long legacy of engineering excellence. After several successful years together, SWDC was carved out as a dedicated entity, bringing sharper focus, marquee investors, and accelerated global expansion.We deliver end-to-end, high-performance, and sustainable data center infrastructure for hyperscalers, BFSI, government, telecom, and colocation clients across global markets including India, the Middle East, and Africa.Our offerings span the full lifecycle – from design & build, modular construction, and AI-powered smart operations, to sustainability execution and round-the-clock O&M services – enabling speed, intelligence, and reliability at every stage.Backed by a robust order book, a growing global footprint, and a team with decades of deep domain expertise, SWDC is poised to lead the next leap in data center innovation.
Unrivaled Execution Track Record (Seamless Execution): We have delivered 100% system uptime across all our projects, even executing and handing over three data centers during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Industry-Leading Expertise (Top Expertise): Our in-house team includes 30+ design engineers, certified professionals, and a dedicated ISAT team, ensuring compliance with Uptime Institute TIER and TIA-942 certifications.
Innovation-Driven Approach (Innovative Strategy) : We specialize in energy-efficient, sustainable, and prefabricated modular data center solutions, making deployment faster and more cost-effective.

Global Footprint: Expanding into new markets such as KSA, DRC, and soon into Southern Africa, we are strategically positioned to capitalize on the massive 6 GW capacity addition expected in India and MEA over the next five years.
We have consistently delivered 100% system uptime across all projects - including the successful execution and handover of three data centers during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Our in-house team comprises 65+ design engineers, certified professionals, and a dedicated ISAT team, ensuring full compliance with various industry standards.
We specialize in energy-efficient, sustainable, and prefabricated modular data center solutions that accelerate deployment and optimize costs.
With growing presence in key markets like KSA and DRC - and expansion into Southern Africa, we’re positioned to support the 6 GW capacity boom across India and MEA over the next five years.
At Sterling & Wilson Data Center (SWDC), we are committed to maintaining the highest standards of health, safety, and environmental responsibility across all operations.

Our integrated management system, aligned with ISO 45001:2018 and ISO 14001:2015, ensures a structured and compliant approach to risk management, regulatory adherence, and continuous improvement. It defines clear roles and responsibilities across the organization and reinforces our focus on safe, sustainable, and efficient project delivery. This commitment reflects our responsibility to our people, our clients, and the environment.

Behind every successful project is a team of seasoned leaders and industry experts who guide our strategy, innovation, and execution. Meet the minds shaping the future of data center infrastructure at SWDC.

Defect Liability Period (DLP) [12 months] – bank guarantee, incident management, and transition to O&M.
Operations & Maintenance (O&M) [36-60 months] – Resource allocation, structured L1-L3 incident management, and long-term infrastructure optimization.
Contract Award – LoA issuance, detailed contract signing, branch/subsidiary formation, BG submission, and insurance processing.
Detailed Design & Engineering – Design validation, detailed engineering, software-based modeling, client approvals, regulatory compliance, value engineering & product optimization.
Procurement – Vendor evaluation, technical compliance checks, competitive global sourcing, vendor selection via reverse auction, and commercial negotiations.
Construction (Site Infra Build) – Civil work, substructure, superstructure, facades, fenestrations, and interiors.
MEP Implementation – Electrical, HVAC, ELV, fire fighting, plumbing, structured cabling.
Testing & Commissioning – Third-party agency appointment, script development, sequence of operation (SOO), L1-L5 testing, ISAT, and RFS (Ready for Service).
Marketing Activities [3 months] – Market identification, customer segmentation, enquiry sourcing, networking & events, referrals, and media outreach.
Pre-Bidding [1 month] – Client due diligence, commercial & financial terms, technical scope identification, risk analysis, migration strategy, PQ activities (client registration), go/no-go decision.
Bidding [1-2 months] – Contract evaluation, technical & execution strategy, value engineering, sourcing plans, project planning, pricing & bid proposal preparation.
Contract Negotiation [2 months] – Finalizing technical, commercial, and execution terms, contract duration, and client expectations.

After several successful years together, SWDC was carved out as a dedicated entity, bringing sharper focus, marquee investors, and accelerated global expansion.

We deliver end-to-end, high-performance, and sustainable data center infrastructure for hyperscalers, BFSI, government, telecom, and colocation clients across global markets including India, the Middle East, and Africa.

Our offerings span the full lifecycle – from design & build, modular construction, and AI-powered smart operations, to sustainability execution and round-the-clock O&M services – enabling speed, intelligence, and reliability at every stage.

We specialize in energy-efficient, sustainable, and prefabricated modular data center solutions, making deployment faster and more cost-effective.
